fullDescription:
Watercolor and texture brushes for Procreate included:
• 11 brushes: with watercolor texture,with press-dependent color saturation, salted watercolor texture, pure water texture, alcohol ink effect, “all in one brush” can used for scetch, water & textured effects
• 1 blur brush
• 2 watercolor paper background brushes (nice for 2500 x 2500 px, change grainy scale for much more canvas)
• 1 color swatches for Procreate

You will receive: 1 brushset file (NOTE: for Procreate version 4.0 or earlier brushset is not available), 1 swatches

How Installing Procreate Brushes (.brush and brushset)
Use this option if you have an older iPad or Procreate version 4.0 or earlier. Here’s how:
1. Download folder .brush file to your folder on your iPad
2. Open the folder and choose .brush files
3. Tap and hold with your finger or apple pencil
4. Choose “Share” from the menu
5. If the option “Open in Procreate” is missing, click on “More”
6. Scroll and find the option “Open in Procreate” and click on it
7. Open your project in Procreate and click on brush icon at the top right corner

Or
1. Open Procreate, click new collection – brush – import
2. Find folder with download brush, choose it, added in Procreate.
